title: Tumaini White Sugar 2Kg is completely out of stock at Nairobi Distribution Centre
description: Tumaini White Sugar 2Kg shows quantityAvailable of zero at Nairobi Distribution Centre. Any sales order for this product at this warehouse cannot currently be fulfilled.
businessContext: INV-POL-001 defines quantityAvailable as quantityOnHand less quantityReserved and any controlled hold.

events.event: Inventory reporting shows quantityOnHand of 0 and quantityAvailable of 0 for Tumaini White Sugar 2Kg at Nairobi Distribution Centre.
No stock is available to reserve against a new sales order at this warehouse.
The Inventory Manager reviews replenishment options, including stock at other warehouses.

expectedOutcome: Tumaini White Sugar 2Kg cannot be sold from Nairobi Distribution Centre until stock is replenished or transferred in; quantityAvailable is exactly 0 (quantityOnHand 0 minus quantityReserved 0). Sales must check other warehouses or trigger a reorder through Inventory before promising this product to a customer from this site.
relevantFacts: Tumaini White Sugar 2Kg (PRD-009) at Nairobi Distribution Centre has quantityOnHand 0, quantityReserved 0, quantityAvailable 0 (inventory record INV-0009).
INV-POL-001: 'quantityAvailable is quantityOnHand less quantityReserved and any controlled hold.'
requiredReasoning: Confirm quantityAvailable is zero by subtracting quantityReserved from quantityOnHand.
Determine that no reservation against a new order is possible at this site.
Identify the next step: check other warehouses or trigger replenishment.
